product_one_liner.value: Open Dental Software provides customizable dental practice management software for dental offices and practices of any size.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes comprehensive, customizable dental practice management software for practices of any size: https://www.opendental.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The public Fees for Support and Services page describes software-license and support fees: https://www.opendental.com/site/fees.html.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Sweet Truth Dental's testimonial explicitly says it chose Open Dental: https://learn.flex.dental/testimonial-sweet-truth-dental. A reviewer associated with Aspen Hill Smiles Family Dentistry describes its office's use of Open Dental: https://www.trustradius.com/reviews/open-dental-software-2021-10-05-09-06-04. | named_customers.0: The page titled "Testimonial Sweet Truth Dental" contains the practice's statement that it chose Open Dental as its software service. | named_customers.1: The same review identifies Aspen Hill Smiles Family Dentistry and describes the office's use of Open Dental for patient care.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 221 employees, which falls within 201-500: https://linkedin.com/company/open-dental-software. Profile counts may differ from payroll headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official contact address and employment page consistently locate the company in Salem, Oregon: https://www.opendental.com/site/contact.html and https://www.opendental.com/site/employment.html. The cited wording identifies its company location rather than explicitly labeling it headquarters. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the United States, consistent with its official Salem, Oregon address: https://linkedin.com/company/open-dental-software and https://www.opendental.com/site/contact.html.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2003: https://www.opendental.com/site/employment.html.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index shows release highlights, product guidance, practice advice and guest content, rather than an engineering publication: https://opendental.blog/. The identified software-engineer Q&A does not establish two engineer-authored posts about building the product: https://opendental.blog/questions-answers-with-an-open-dental-expert-software-engineer.

public_docs.notes: Public programming resources link to database-schema and API documentation, and the developer portal provides instructions and request examples: https://www.opendental.com/site/programmingresources.html and https://www.opendental.com/site/apideveloperportal.html.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers page lists support, software/network engineering, facilities and childcare positions, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title: https://www.opendental.com/site/employment.html.

model_provider.value: BetterDiagnostics (natively integrated AI radiograph image analysis)
model_provider.notes: Open Dental documents BetterDiagnostics as a third-party AI radiograph-analysis program natively integrated into its Imaging Module: https://www.opendental.com/site/betterdiagnostics.html. This identifies an integrated AI provider, not an underlying foundation model.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company claims adherence to HIPAA guidelines and standards and maintains HIPAA procedures: https://www.opendental.com/site/hipaaopendental.html. This is a public compliance claim, not evidence of an independent HIPAA certification. | compliance_certs.0: The official HIPAA page explicitly claims adherence to HIPAA guidelines and standards; this is not presented as independent certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company is explicitly described as unfunded, with no funding raised, supporting stage "none": https://tracxn.com/d/companies/opendental/__0A2CdUck8mtb68pPQSt1jt9GgwjdITyrSarRQpFdc7I. | funding_date: No funding round is reported, so a latest-round date is inapplicable and left null: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/opendental/__0A2CdUck8mtb68pPQSt1jt9GgwjdITyrSarRQpFdc7I. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile reports no funding, so there is no latest-round amount to report; null is not an asserted zero-dollar round: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/opendental/__0A2CdUck8mtb68pPQSt1jt9GgwjdITyrSarRQpFdc7I.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports no funding raised at all, supporting false for the preceding 18 months: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/opendental/__0A2CdUck8mtb68pPQSt1jt9GgwjdITyrSarRQpFdc7I.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page is readable and lists positions, but none is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive: https://www.opendental.com/site/employment.html. Support and phone-triage roles are not treated as sales roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Version 26.1 became stable on August 6, 2026, within the six-month window, and its release includes the ODTouch 25 app rather than only bug fixes or cosmetic changes: https://www.opendental.com/site/version26_1.html. The release also appears on https://opendental.blog/.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The team listing and available executive profiles did not establish a complete, dated leadership history or a qualifying appointment/departure announcement. Sources checked included https://theorg.com/org/open-dental-software and https://linkedin.com/in/nathan-sparks-97673425; they do not support a reliable yes or no.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A public technology profile lists Adobe Marketing Cloud under Open Dental Software's marketing technology: https://rocketreach.co/open-dental-software-technology-stack_b54a5c01f6a6c176. This is a third-party stack signal, not company-confirmed deployment. | crm_stack_signal.0: The public technology profile associates Adobe Marketing Cloud with Open Dental Software's marketing technology, providing a third-party stack signal.
